CLI Capabilities

Designed for AI Agent Orchestration

Artifex is built from the ground up for Personal / Coding Agents. It executes canvases programmatically without rendering a browser wrapper.

Headless Execution Performance

Leverage local graphics drivers to compile and execute complex multi-track timelines completely offline (except AI nodes), executing parallel node structures.

Declarative JSON Graph Specs

Construct specs using simplified dynamic imports and custom fonts. Avoid complex database mock records—write JSON graphs and let Artifex resolve them.

Checkpoint State Caching

Cache execution states from remote generators. Fast-reload checkpoints to instantly modify visual positions locally without repeating network calls.

A coded exit contract

Every Artifex run returns a machine-meaningful exit code so agents can route failures programmatically — no parsing terminal prose.

0SUCCESSExecution completed successfully
2INPUT_ERRORBad args / missing file / schema
3GRAPH_ERRORCycles or unknown node refs
4RENDER_ERRORRenderer engine failure
5PROVIDER_ERRORMissing API key
7FATAL_ERRORUnhandled exception

Native JSON on stdout

Pass --json and the CLI emits structured results agents can consume directly.

$ artifex run spec.json --json
{
  "canvasId": "b0f3a1e2",
  "results": {
    "image-gen-node": { "output": "renders/output.png" },
    "modulate-sepia": { "filter": "sepia(0.85)" }
  },
  "nodeIds": { "image-gen-node": "node_4f2a" }
}

The working arrangement

An execution runtime for agent-authored media.

Artifex gives an agent a clear path from a workflow idea to a finished artifact: describe the graph, validate the contract, run what is needed, inspect the work, and export with confidence.

01

A portable contract

JSON carries nodes, handles, dependencies, and export intent in one inspectable document.

02

A recoverable process

Checkpoint state lets agents resume, revise, and export again without repeating paid work.

03

A shared language

The same node processors and graph semantics carry from agent-authored work into production.

04

A GPU-native finish

Visual composition is rendered on capable local GPU, with execution kept explicit and observable.

A Note from the Team

We built Gatewai to bring all generative AI models, Photoshop-like editing features, audio design tools, and your own media assets together onto a single infinite canvas. By consolidating these capabilities into one unified space, we wanted to deliver an elegant user experience that is exceptionally easy to use, making creative experimentation intuitive and seamless.
